# fetch — mcp-server-fetch
# Generated by Humcp.Schema.Tests. Do not hand-edit; see GoldenTests.

### fetch
    title: Fetch
  url                              Text           T1 required
      help: URL to fetch
      limits: At least 1 character, a URL.
  max_length                       Integer        T1
      label: Max Length
      help: Maximum number of characters to return.
      limits: Greater than 0 and less than 1000000.
      default: 5000
  start_index                      Integer        T1
      label: Start Index
      help: On return output starting at this character index, useful if a previous fetch was truncated and more context is required.
      limits: At least 0.
      default: 0
  raw                              Boolean        T1
      help: Get the actual HTML content of the requested page, without simplification.
      default: false
